study type: Retrospective and Prospective Observational, Record Analytic Study
cohort: Participants included women receiving care during pregnancy and childbirth and their newborns at IPGMER-SSKM Hospital in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, with a focus on those experiencing maternal or perinatal mortality.
finding: The study reported a Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR) of (378-678) per 100,000 live births and a Perinatal Mortality Rate (PNMR) of (58-62) per 1000 live births.
